runtime_note: Loaded module paths observed inside benchmark process. Empty module list may mean static runtime linkage; inspect PE imports. Probe failure does not identify the root cause.
timer: std::chrono::steady_clock; start/stop on the main caller thread; wall elapsed time, not clock()/CPU time.

timing_scope.api: Entire solver call on original CSR: result/workspace allocation and initialization, validation/normalization for serial scan and OpenMP, OpenMP team entry/exit, and cleanup of internal workspace/normalized temporary. Existing heap does not validate CSR.
timing_scope.sssp_prepared: Solve using the same already-validated/normalized CSR snapshot. Includes result/workspace allocation and initialization, workspace cleanup and OpenMP team entry/exit. Excludes validation/normalization. Serial scan contains no OpenMP construct.
timing_scope.preparation: PreparedDijkstraGraph construction only: validation, row sorting, duplicate-edge coalescing, owning CSR allocation; excludes destruction.
timing_scope.excluded: Input generation, file IO, result verification and result destruction. API/prepared speedups use serial scan of the SAME scope; preparation median is not subtracted from API median.

structural_review.organization: One persistent parallel region encloses all vertex-selection iterations. Per-thread minima merged by single; no critical per candidate. Selection, single publication, and relaxation retain phase barriers.
structural_review.granularity: Graph-level mean/max outgoing degree and per-probe-team vertices/relax-edges recorded; this is a workload-size diagnostic, not a measured barrier-cost attribution.
